current.title: Round 58 DELIVERED — the desktop-polish round (first fully-working Windows session)
current.detail: The owner's eleventh Windows test session: 'This time the application works properly. The app opens up without any errors or any issues at all.' — the R57 engine-bundling fix held, and the session's defect list became this round: the native title bar is gone (a 40px integrated title bar with drag + min/max/close), the pop-out browser window is no longer a white box (async creation + initialization-script overlay), 'open in system browser' works, the URL bar survives typing, viewport readouts are honest, stops render a quiet 'Stopped by user' card (no more generation-failed/body-stream-aborted), the session status resets (no eternal sidebar spinner), the partial reply persists and a Continue button resumes it, tool arguments stream live so files show a 'writing <file>' preview DURING generation, history replay caps stale tool output (the end-of-task session regurgitation), the thinking blocks lost their AI-glow rails, the context popover waits 600ms for hover intent, Settings/Models-Providers/Sub-agents/Advanced were restructured (unconfigured presets grouped, preset fields hidden, proper disable toggle, content-sized provider list, single sub-agent home), every API key is revealable with a click, and the CLI chat harness drives whole sessions from the terminal. Verification: 1169 + 631 tests green, lint/typecheck clean, docs:check 149/0, LIVE battery 5/5 (the owner's exact 3-file task with live tool-input frames, stop → queued + persisted partial, continue completes, reveal route) — scripts/battery-r58.mjs is the permanent artifact.
